trigger_condition: Unicode expands serialized evidence past the diagnostic ceiling.
guard_snippet: Bound fields before serialization and retain complete Unicode JSON.
resolution: Headers limited to 80 characters; ensure_ascii=False; Unicode regression passes.

trigger_condition: An oversized numeric retry header is rejected before diagnostics.
guard_snippet: Attach HTTP/context/response evidence to retry-delay validation failures.
potential_consequence: A 403 loses its authentication and response context.
resolution: Delay-validation failures retain bounded diagnostics; both oversized headers tested.

trigger_condition: An API message contains an unfamiliar signed or credential-bearing URL.
guard_snippet: Omit response-message URLs before retaining text.
resolution: Response URLs omitted; unfamiliar signature regression passes.

trigger_condition: Artifact-download errors still use their original diagnostics.
guard_snippet: Narrow the documented guarantee to JSON API requests.
resolution: Documentation explicitly preserves existing artifact-download diagnostics.

trigger_condition: Bodies cannot be parsed/read or exceed limits.
potential_consequence: Operators cannot distinguish absent message from collection failure.

trigger_condition: A permissions or response header exceeds the retained bound.
guard_snippet: Mark clipped fields explicitly within their limit.
potential_consequence: A partial required-permissions expression appears complete.

trigger_condition: A job/token/caller has less than two seconds left.
guard_snippet: Exercise short enclosing deadlines and exhausted budgets.
potential_consequence: The slow-body bound is verified only with generous fake time.
resolution: Real-clock job/token/caller tests and expired-budget no-read test pass.

trigger_condition: PUT/PATCH failures have unreadable diagnostic bodies.
guard_snippet: Assert original status and one write without retry.
resolution: PUT/PATCH unreadable-body refusals retain status and make exactly one request.

trigger_condition: The response echoes another registered controller credential.
guard_snippet: Test redaction of active and other registered secrets.
potential_consequence: The diagnostic could reveal a different held token.
resolution: Active token and distinct registered polling token are both removed.

guard_snippet: Assert final-response evidence, closure and retry counts.
potential_consequence: Only terminal 403 diagnostics have direct coverage.
resolution: Terminal 429/503 exact final request IDs, attempt counts, closure and delays pass.

trigger_condition: Unicode expands serialized evidence past the diagnostic ceiling.
guard_snippet: Bound fields before serialization and retain complete Unicode JSON.
resolution: Headers limited to 80 characters; ensure_ascii=False; Unicode regression passes.

trigger_condition: An oversized numeric retry header is rejected before diagnostics.
guard_snippet: Attach HTTP/context/response evidence to retry-delay validation failures.
potential_consequence: A 403 loses its authentication and response context.
resolution: Delay-validation failures retain bounded diagnostics; both oversized headers tested.

trigger_condition: Malformed/oversized/no-message cases do not assert their exact body_status.
guard_snippet: Parameterize payloads with expected statuses and assert each exact status.
potential_consequence: An in-memory removal of the invalid-json assignment passes the earlier tests.
resolution: Exact invalid-json/oversized/no-message/unreadable assertions pass on both interpreters; reviewer confirmed closure.
